g.text: CRUDE & VACUUM DISTILLATION UNIT - OVERALL UNIT PLOT
1. Coordinates in metres from unit plot SW corner (E = x, N = y). Grade EL 100.000.
2. Equipment positions = centrelines; outlines to equipment list CFU-000-ME-LST-001.
3. Air coolers (dashed) on structure above rack tier 3, bundles at EL 115.0.
4. Spacing per CCPS 'Guidelines for Facility Siting & Layout' / GAP 2.5.2 typical values;
5. distances edge-to-edge of plan bounding boxes (conservative), see table.
6. Final spacing subject to HAC, fire & explosion and API RP 752 siting study.
7. Fired heaters south of rack, upwind of HC equipment (prevailing wind SSE).
8. Rack bents at 6 m; 12 m portal span over west perimeter road RD-W.
9. SW perimeter road deviated north of SS-100 / FAR-100 (frame conflict, see report).
BP-1 BUNDLE PULL AISLE (9.5 m clear, bundles 7.5 m) -> RD-W
MAIN PIPE RACK PR-100 (10 m wide, bents @ 6 m, TOS EL 106.0 / 108.5 / 111.0)
GRID 10 m. COORDINATES E/N IN m.
Shell & tube exch. (bar = channel / pull end)
Air cooler bay on rack (EL 115.0), fans
Fired heater to HC process equipment
Fired heater to LPG / light-ends equipment
Fired heater to main pipe rack
Fired heater to unit flare KO drum
Fired heater to fuel-gas KO drum
project typ. 15 m (API RP 752 siting study to confirm)
HC pumps not beneath air coolers (plan clearance)
project typ. >= 5.0 m (mobile crane not permitted)
Max travel from equipment to escape route / road
All distances edge-to-edge (m) of plan bounding boxes; columns use circumscribed square (conservative).
EQUIPMENT LOCATION SCHEDULE (CENTRELINE COORDINATES, m; BASE / TOP EL)
- Area 100 west: desalting (south of rack), preheat exchangers (north, 2 rows + pull aisle)
- Light ends C-105/C-106 north-west, > 30 m from fired heaters (LPG spacing)
- Area 100 centre: C-101 + side strippers C-102/3/4, OH system D-102/E-115 under A-101
- Fired heaters H-101 / H-201 south band y 20-50 (upwind, SSE wind), FG KO D-103
- Area 200 east: C-201, ejector structure ST-201 + hotwell D-201 (barometric legs)
- Pump rows CL 3.5 m (N) / 4.5 m (S) off rack edge, grouped below their suction vessels
- Air coolers on rack top over the systems they serve (OH, products, light ends, VGO)
